worksheet.title: Growth Strategy Worksheet
worksheet.description: Define your growth approach and update your Founder Rules for the next phase.

fields.label: Growth strategy
fields.helpText: What is your primary growth move right now?
options: Go deeper on the current product
Add a second product for the same customer
Add a product for a new customer

fields.label: Why this approach
fields.helpText: What evidence or reasoning led you to this choice? Be honest about constraints.

fields.label: Second store considerations
fields.helpText: If considering a second store: is your first store operationally stable? Can it run a week without daily involvement? What market have you identified?

fields.label: Updated time budget
fields.helpText: How many hours per week are you committing now? Has this changed from Chapter 4?

fields.label: Updated monthly cap
fields.helpText: Your new monthly spending limit. If the business is generating revenue, does this now come from business earnings rather than personal savings?

fields.label: Updated decision thresholds
fields.helpText: Recalibrate your kill, continue, and escalation criteria for this more mature stage of the business.
